propositions: Three near-identical walkers discover replacement links by iterating deps for duplicates then calling find_inbound_relationships for supersedes, differing only in liveness check and return type, causing maintenance burden and inconsistent rule application.

The replacement-link walk (conjunction of find_inbound_relationships and 'supersedes' literal) must appear in exactly one location under src/rebar (close_disposition.py) with a reasoned # replacement-walk-ok escape marker to prevent reintroduction of divergence.

Class and ticket_type filtering for DISPOSITION_CLASSES and ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES narrowing must stay at each wrapper rather than merge into shared core, because the three callers differ and merging would weaken fail-closed verification paths.
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must be defined as a direct reference to close_disposition.DISPOSITION_CLASSES (same object, not merely equal) so the two sets cannot drift independently.

The three monkeypatch seams (_has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, find_replacement) must retain their exact names and signatures to prevent silent test failure when patched with raising=False.
